ar.work.not_placed_body: Snap a corner or scan a board, then everything here works.
ar.work.nothing_there: Nothing modelled there. Try tapping right on a pipe or unit.
ar.work.photo_failed: Couldn't take the photo. Try again.
bim_viewer.title: Model viewer
bim_viewer.walk_hint: Drag to look · stick to walk
bim_viewer.layer_cut_hint: In orbit, walls and slabs above 2.2 m are cut away so rooms show from above. Services stay.
bim_viewer.walls_from_plan: Walls drawn from the floor plan until this floor's solid walls are downloaded or built.
bim_viewer.download_subtitle: %a · works offline afterwards, in AR too
bim_viewer.no_plan_title: No plan for this floor yet
bim_viewer.no_plan_subtitle: The plan comes from the floor's model once it's built.
bim_viewer.search_unavailable: The element list loads once this floor's model has been opened with signal
bim_viewer.panel_nothing: Tap an element in 3D or equipment on the plan
permits.title: Permit to Work
permits.empty_subtitle: Permits you raise or are crew on will show up here.
permits.load_error_sub: Check your connection and try again.
permits.scan_not_found_sub: This QR code doesn't match a permit we can find. Try again once you have a connection.
permits.up_to_date: Nothing needs your attention right now.
permits.gas_not_required: This permit doesn't require gas testing.
permits.isolations_empty: No isolation points on this permit.
permits.restore_confirm_message: This removes the lock and tag. Only do this once it's safe to restore energy.
permits.complete_confirm_message: This tells the office the work is finished and ready for close-out.
permits.fire_watch_confirm_message: Confirm the area has been checked and there's no sign of fire.
permits.fire_watch_running: Watching the area until the countdown ends.
permits.fire_watch_elapsed: The watch period has ended — check the area, then sign off.
permits.stop_work_subtitle: This suspends the permit immediately. Anyone on site can do this.
permits.gas_test_subtitle: O2, then LEL, H2S and CO — colours update as you type.
permits.gas_test_will_suspend: This reading will fail and suspend live work.
permits.gas_test_auto_suspended: This test failed — the permit has been suspended.
permits.try_out_hint: Try the equipment and confirm it does not start or move.
permits.briefing_ack: I've been briefed on the hazards, controls and PPE above, and I understand them.
permits.signature_required: A signature is required to sign on.
ar.baseline.body: Walk 2–5 m along either wall from corner 1. Tap where that wall meets the floor.
ar.baseline.chip: Tap the base of a wall 2–5 m away
ar.baseline.done_short: Heading set from the wall. Snap a second corner to lock.
ar.baseline.hint: The farther along the wall, the straighter the model.
ar.baseline.not_along: That point isn't along a wall of corner 1 (%a m away). Tap the base of one of its walls.
ar.baseline.nudge: Heading from one corner is rough. Tap the base of a wall 2–5 m along it, or snap a second corner.
ar.baseline.title: Set the heading
ar.baseline.too_short: Only %a m from corner 1. Walk at least 2 m along the wall.
ar.coach.check_body: Make sure the wall outlines sit on the real walls. Use the colour legend to show or hide services, and Drill check before you drill into a wall.
ar.coach.snap_body: Put the pin on a room corner at floor level and tap Snap. Do it at a second corner a few metres away and the model locks on.
ar.coach.sweep_body: Move the phone slowly across the walls and floor near a corner so it can measure the room. Good light helps.
ar.corner.coach_edge: Aim the pin at the line where the two walls meet the floor.
ar.corner.coach_no_walls: Walls not detected — tap each wall 3 times near the corner.
ar.corner.coach_texture: Plain painted walls? Tape a printed textured strip near the corner so the phone can see them.
ar.debug.title: Debug · ARCore recording
ar.handoff.photo_attached: The AR photo is attached below
ar.handoff.tag_differs: The scanned tag belongs to a different asset
ar.handoff.tag_matches: The scanned tag matches this asset
ar.handoff.title: From AR
ar.handoff.unchecked: Location not checked: the tag wasn't scanned in AR
ar.install.not_enabled_body: Your organisation hasn't enabled AR board installs for your account. Ask your administrator.
ar.layers.section_sub: Hides everything above %a from the floor
ar.layers.xray_sub: Pipes, ducts and cables hidden in walls, floors and ceilings are drawn through them
ar.progress.queued_hint: %a waiting for signal. The server has the final say on sync.
ar.progress.refused_on_sync: %a refused by the server after sync
ar.recheck.relocalized: Tracking jumped. Re-check a corner or board.
ar.recheck.tracking_lost: Tracking was lost. Re-check a corner or board.
ar.recheck.walked: You've walked %a m since the last check. Re-check a corner or board.
ar.tool.torch_soon: Torch: coming in a later update
ar.walls.body_a: Tap one wall 3 to 5 times near the corner, spread out between knee and head height.
ar.walls.body_b: Now tap the other wall of the corner the same way.
ar.walls.fitted: Corner found from the walls (±%a mm)
ar.walls.floor: That's the floor. Tap the wall itself.
ar.walls.hint: Tap flat painted wall, not skirting, door frames or furniture. Stay 1–2 m away.
ar.walls.low_confidence: That tap was uncertain. Tap again, a bit closer.
ar.walls.no_depth: Couldn't measure there. Move a little closer or tap a spot with some texture.
ar.walls.parallel: Both walls look the same. Tap the other wall of the corner.
ar.walls.spread_out: Spread the taps out along the wall.
ar.walls.title: Tap wall %a
ar.walls.too_far: Those taps don't meet near a corner. Tap closer to the corner.
ar.walls.too_few: Tap at least 3 times on each wall.
ar.toast.refocusing: Refocusing… hold still for a moment.
ar.setup.double_tap_focus: Blurry? Double-tap the camera to refocus.
ar.power.idle_body: No movement for 2 minutes, so the camera is off. Tap anywhere to carry on — the model stays where it was.
ar.power.hot_body: The phone is getting hot. Let it cool for a minute, then tap to carry on.
ar.toast.warm: Phone is warming up. Pause AR when you are not using it.
ar.power.continue_note: Heat protection stays off for this session. The phone may slow down; it still stops at its emergency level.
ar.power.override_on: Heat protection off for this session.
conv.title: Conversation
conv.grounded_dropped: %a claim(s) left out — not in your data
conv.queued: You're offline — this will send by itself when there's signal
conv.composer_hint: Write a comment, @ to mention someone
conv.composer_hint_agents: Write a comment, @agent to ask the AI teammate
conv.chip_watch_text: tell me when this is closed
conv.hint_add_agent: Sounds like a reminder. Add @agent so it sets this up.
conv.hint_agents_off: Your role can't ask AI teammates yet. Your comment is still posted.
conv.hint_schedule: Flow Agent will set up a schedule and show it here.
conv.agents_off_note: Asking AI teammates isn't turned on for your role.
conv.saved_copy: No signal — showing the saved copy. New messages send when you're back online.
conv.empty_subtitle: Start the conversation. Type @ to mention someone.
conv.empty_subtitle_agents: Start the conversation. Type @agent to ask the AI teammate, or "@agent remind me…" for a reminder.
conv.preview_empty_agents: No comments yet. Mention @agent to ask the AI teammate about this snag.
conv.snag_local_only: The conversation opens once this snag reaches the office.
conv.follow: Follow — notify me of new messages
schedules.title: My schedules
schedules.profile_sub: Reminders and checks you asked the AI teammate for
schedules.empty_subtitle: In any snag or work-order conversation, write "@agent remind me every Monday at 8 to…" and it shows up here.
schedules.offline: You're offline. Schedules need a connection — pull down to try again.
